# Rafay's Agent

> Scoped personal site agent for Rafay Syed. Responds via Claude at rafaysyed.dev for humans and other agents (A2A-style JSON-RPC). Not a general-purpose assistant.

## Agent protocols

- Agent card: https://rafaysyed.dev/.well-known/agent.json
- A2A messaging: POST https://rafaysyed.dev/api/a2a — JSON-RPC 2.0, method "message/send"
- Optional Tesla (Fleet + Google Directions for trips; door lock/unlock via Fleet when tools allow): same A2A URL with server-configured `x-a2a-tesla-secret` header (or `Authorization: Bearer …`); requires OAuth scopes including vehicle data (`vehicle_location` for car GPS; `vehicle_cmds` for wake and lock/unlock).
- Optional owner-authenticated tone: `x-a2a-owner-secret` matching server `A2A_OWNER_SECRET`, or reuse the Tesla secret header (same effect for identity). Other callers get the public agent only.
- This file: https://rafaysyed.dev/llms.txt
